chapter.v:
Moses and
the Israelite elders of Israel gave these instructions to the people: Keep all the commandments I am giving you today.

The day
you cross the Jordan into the country the Lord your God is giving you, set up some large stones and paint them with whitewash.

Then write
all these laws on them once you've crossed over to enter the country that the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord, the God of your forefathers, promised you.

After you've
crossed the Jordan, you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal, having painted them with whitewash, as I've ordered you to do today.

Also build
a stone altar there to the Lord your God, an altar of stones. Don't use any stone tools in its construction.

Build the
altar of the Lord your God with uncut stones and sacrifice burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God.

That is
also where you are to sacrifice and eat your peace offerings, celebrating in the presence of the Lord your God.

Write all
these laws clearly on the stones.

Moses and
the Levitical priests gave these orders to all the Israelites: “Be quiet, people of Israel, and listen! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.

So obey
what the Lord your God tells you, and follow commandments and regulations that I'm giving you today.”

That day
Moses gave these orders to the people:

After you've
crossed the Jordan, the following tribes are to stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

The following
tribes are to stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

Then the
Levites will shout in a loud voice so every Israelite can hear:

“A curse
on anyone who makes a carved image or a metal idol and worships it in secret. It's only an object that someone made, and it's offensive to the Lord!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who dishonors their father or mother.” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who moves their neighbor's boundary stone!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who allows a blind man to wander in the road!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who doesn't treat foreigners, the orphans, and widows fairly!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on any man who sleeps with his father's wife, for he has disgraced his father!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who has sex with any animal!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on any man who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on any man who sleeps with his mother-in-law!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who secretly attacks his neighbor!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who accepts a bribe to kill someone who's innocent!” Everyone says “Amen!”

“A curse
on anyone who doesn't carefully obey all these laws by keeping them!” Everyone says “Amen!”
